The Samurai begins at the Behemoth's feet and performs one continuous supernatural bottom-to-head vertical katana strike, traveling upward through the center of the creature and finishing at its head. The camera tracks vertically upward alongside the Samurai and blade. Use extreme slow motion at the peak of the strike, with a brilliant blue-white energy trail extending through the entire body.

After the Samurai lands behind the Behemoth, hold the shot for one dramatic second. A glowing vertical cut line appears from the bottom of the creature to the top of its head. The two sides slowly separate. The Cyst Behemoth then splits into two large sections and falls in opposite directions. The impact produces a massive cinematic dust shockwave, drifting smoke, debris and glowing orange energy from its cysts. Keep the creature destruction dramatic and stylized without excessive graphic gore.

Finish with the Samurai standing calmly in the foreground as the two sections of the Behemoth collapse behind him. He flicks the katana, sheathes it with a sharp metallic sound and walks forward through the smoke without looking back.

Samurai は非常に俊敏な超自然的動きで反撃します。彼は Behemoth の巨大な腕の上を走り、空中回転を行い、katana を抜きます。

約12秒の時点で、Samurai の4連続の剣撃を開始してください。FIRST SLASH: Behemoth の胴体を素早く水平に斬り、青白いエネルギーの軌跡を残す。SECOND SLASH: 空中から上半身に対する斜め斬り。THIRD SLASH: 体の別の部位への強力な水平斬り。FOURTH SLASH: クリーチャーの周囲を高速で回り込んだ後、背後から放つ超自然的な高速斬撃。各斬撃には、それぞれ異なる剣のサウンドデザイン、制御された motion blur、火花、エネルギーの軌跡、煙の押しのけ、そして cinematic な camera movement を持たせてください。
